name: drawthesystem
description: System design interview practice with any AI coding agent + Excalidraw. Skills for research, scenarios, mock interviews (text/voice), diagram critique, reference solutions.
author: Jeremy Ettlinger

scripts.check: node --test core/test/*.test.mjs && bun scripts/excalidraw.mjs examples/sample-spec.json /tmp/sdp-check.excalidraw && bun scripts/read-excalidraw.mjs /tmp/sdp-check.excalidraw > /dev/null && node --input-type=module -e "const c = (await import('./core/content/node.mjs')).loadContent(); if (c.skills.length < 8) throw new Error('missing skills'); console.log('content ok (' + c.skills.length + ' skills, ' + c.rubric.dimensions.length + ' rubric dimensions)')" && echo scripts ok
